properties.name: file
properties.description: File path. Falls back to the Root `file` when omitted.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Line number. Renders an empty gutter cell when nullish.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: Number tone. Rows pass their own type; standalone use defaults to context.

properties.name: additions
properties.description: Addition count. Falls back to the Root count when omitted.

properties.name: deletions
properties.description: Deletion count. Falls back to the Root count when omitted.

properties.name: file
properties.description: File path shown in the top bar, e.g. "src/auth.ts".

properties.name: lang
properties.description: Highlight.js language id used for every row unless a row overrides it.

properties.name: additions
properties.description: Addition count. Defaults to the number of `add` lines in `diff`.

properties.name: deletions
properties.description: Deletion count. Defaults to the number of `remove` lines in `diff`.

properties.name: diff
properties.description: High-level unified lines. When set, Root renders TopBar and Content itself.

properties.name: showLineNumbers
properties.description: Render the old/new line-number gutters.

properties.name: theme
properties.description:
Syntax paint:
- `mielui` (default): the built-in GitHub palette.
- `custom`: no token colors; load any `highlight.js/styles/*` theme instead.

properties.name: type
properties.description: Row kind. Drives the tint, gutter bar, and sign.

properties.name: oldLine
properties.description: Old-file line number. Empty when nullish.

properties.name: newLine
properties.description: New-file line number. Empty when nullish.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Raw source for the row. Highlighted with the Root (or row) language.

properties.name: lang
properties.description: Row-level language override.

properties.name: file
properties.description: File path. Falls back to the Root `file` when omitted.

properties.name: additions
properties.description: Addition count. Falls back to the Root count when omitted.

properties.name: deletions
properties.description: Deletion count. Falls back to the Root count when omitted.

properties.name: children
properties.description:
Trailing actions, pinned to the right edge. Passing children takes
over the row: the default filename and counts are omitted, so compose
them back explicitly with `Filename` and `PlusMinus` as needed.
